items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: And we came to New York and joined Lou Henry's band... we worked with Lou Henry.

ctx.x: And we came to New York and joined Lou Henry's band. He put us up there in his apartment on 135th Street, between Seventh and Eighth Avenues. And he got us one room with the landlady there and we worked with Lou Henry. He had a little band around here. He was playing mostly theaters, with acts.
